chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad from Salih ibn Abi Hammad from al-Husayn ibn Yazeed from Ali ibn Abi Hamza from Ibrahim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, when He caused Adam (peace be upon him) to descend, commanded him with ploughing and planting, and cast down to him a shoot from the shoots of Paradise, so He gave him the palm tree, the grapes, the olives, and the pomegranate, so he planted them so that they would be for his offspring and descendants.

So he ate from its fruits, then Iblis (may Allah curse him) said to him: 'O Adam, what is this shoot which I did not know in the earth, although I was in it before you? Allow me to eat something from it.' So Adam (peace be upon him) refused to let him.

So Iblis came at the end of the lifetime of Adam (peace be upon him) and said to Hawwa: 'Hunger and thirst have exhausted me.' So Hawwa said to him: 'So what do you want?' He said: 'I want you to make me taste from these fruits.' So Hawwa said: 'Adam (peace be upon him) has made me vow that I will not feed you anything from this shoot because it is from Paradise, and it is not befitting for you to eat anything from it.'

So he said to her: 'So squeeze something of it in my palm.' But she refused to him. So he said: 'Allow me to suck it and I will not eat it.' So she took a cluster of grapes and gave it to him, so he sucked it and did not eat from it because Hawwa had insisted upon him. So when he went to bite it, Hawwa pulled it from his mouth.

So Allah, Blessed and High, revealed to Adam (peace be upon him): 'The grapes have been sucked by My enemy and your enemy, Iblis, and I have prohibited upon you from the juice of wine that which was mixed with the breath of Iblis.'

So wine was prohibited because the enemy of Allah, Iblis, plotted with Hawwa until he sucked the grapes. And if he had eaten it, the vine would have been prohibited from its beginning to its end, and all its fruit, and whatever comes out of it.

Then he said to Hawwa: 'If only you would let me suck something from this date as you let me suck from the grapes.' So she gave him a date, so he sucked it. And the grapes and the date were more intense in scent and purer than Al-Azfar musk, and sweeter than honey. So when the enemy of Allah, Iblis (may Allah curse him), sucked them, their scent went away and their sweetness decreased.

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Then Iblis (may Allah curse him) went after the death of Adam (peace be upon him) and urinated at the root of the vine and the palm tree. So the water flowed upon their veins from the urine of the enemy of Allah. From there, the grapes and the dates ferment. So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, prohibited upon the offspring of Adam (peace be upon him) every intoxicant, because the water flowed with the urine of the enemy of Allah in the palm tree and the grapes, and every fermented thing became wine, because the water fermented in the palm tree and the vine from the scent of the urine of the enemy of Allah, Iblis (may Allah curse him).'
ai.seo_question: What is the theological and narrative reason for the prohibition of wine in Shia tradition according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This unique narrative from al-Kafi presents a metaphysical origin for the prohibition of intoxicants, linking the physical fermentation of grapes and dates to the spiritual impurity introduced by Iblis’s interaction with Adam’s progeny. Scholars note that this hadith emphasizes the causal link between the 'breath' or essence of the devil and the natural process of fermentation, thereby elevating the prohibition of khamr from a mere legal ruling to a cosmic consequence of the primordial fall. It underscores the Shia tradition of viewing physical substances as carrying spiritual traces of their origins.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Al Husayn Bin Yazeed, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Ibrahim, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘When Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Caused Adam<sup>as</sup> to descend, Commanded him<sup>as</sup> with the ploughing and the planting and Forwarded to him<sup>as</sup> plants from the plants of the Paradise. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Gave him<sup>as</sup> the palm tree, and the grapes, and the olives, and the pomegranate. So he<sup>as</sup> planted these for it to be for his<sup>as</sup> offspring.

So he<sup>as</sup> ate from its fruits, so Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, said to him<sup>as</sup>, ‘O Adam<sup>as</sup>! What is this plant which I<sup>la</sup> do not happen to recognise it in the earth, and I<sup>la</sup> was here before you<sup>as</sup>, and was not Permitted to eat anything from these?’ So Adam<sup>la</sup> refused to invite him<sup>la</sup>.

So Iblees<sup>la</sup> came over at the end of the lifetime of Adam<sup>as</sup> and said to Hawwa<sup>as</sup>, ‘The hunger and the thirst has exhausted me<sup>la</sup>’. So she<sup>as</sup> said: ‘So what is it which you<sup>la</sup> want?’ He<sup>la</sup> said, ‘I<sup>la</sup> want you<sup>as</sup> to make me<sup>la</sup> taste from these fruits’. So Hawwa<sup>as</sup> said: ‘Adam<sup>as</sup> has made me<sup>as</sup> vow that I<sup>as</sup> would not feed you<sup>la</sup> anything from these plants because these are from the Paradise, and it is not befitting for you<sup>la</sup> that you<sup>la</sup> should be eating from it’.

So he<sup>la</sup> said to her<sup>as</sup>, ‘So squeeze its juice in my<sup>la</sup> palm, something from it’. But she<sup>as</sup> refused to him<sup>la</sup>. So he<sup>la</sup> said, ‘Allow me<sup>la</sup> to suck from it and I<sup>la</sup> will not eat it’. So she<sup>as</sup> took a cluster of grapes and gave it to him<sup>la</sup>. So he<sup>la</sup> sucked it, and did not eat from it. When Hawwa<sup>as</sup> was assured over it, he<sup>la</sup> went on to bite it, and Hawwa<sup>as</sup> seized it from his<sup>la</sup> mouth.

So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Revealed unto Adam<sup>as</sup>: “The grapes have been sucked by My<sup>azwj</sup> enemy and your<sup>as</sup> enemy Iblees<sup>la</sup>, and I<sup>azwj</sup> have Prohibited upon you<sup>as</sup> from the wine juice what the breath of Iblees<sup>la</sup> had been mixed with”.

Thus, the Prohibition of the wine is because Iblees<sup>la</sup> the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had plotted against Hawwa<sup>as</sup> until he<sup>la</sup> sucked the grapes, and had he<sup>la</sup> eaten it, the grapes would have been Prohibited from its beginning to its end, and the entirety of its fruits, and whatever comes out from it’.

Then he<sup>la</sup> said to Hawwa<sup>as</sup>, ‘If only you<sup>as</sup> would let me<sup>la</sup> suck from these dates just as you<sup>as</sup> let me<sup>la</sup> suck from the grapes’. So she<sup>as</sup> gave him a date. So he<sup>la</sup> touched it, and the grapes and the dates used to be more intensely aromatic and pure than the Al-Azfar musk, and sweeter than the honey. So when Iblees<sup>la</sup> the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> touched it, both their aromas and their sweetness was reduced’.

Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, after the passing away of Adam<sup>as</sup> went and urinated in the roots of the grapes and the palm tree. So the water flowed upon its veins from the urine of the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So from then onwards, the grapes and the dates produced wine. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Prohibited upon the offspring of Adam<sup>as</sup>, every intoxicant, because the water flowed by the urine of the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> in the palm tree and the grapes, and every fermented is wine, because the water fermented in the palm tree and the grape from the smell of the urine of the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Salih ibn abu Hammad from af-Husayn ibn Yazid from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from Ibrahim who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘When Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, made Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam to descend, He commanded him to farm and plant and threw to him a plant from the plant of the garden (paradises). He gave him palm trees, grape vines, olives and pomegranates. He planted them for his offspring and descendents.

He ate from its fruits. Iblis, may Allah condemn him, asked, ‘What are these plantations, O Adam, which I did not know of on earth even though I was here before you? Will you allow me to eat from them something?’ Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam did not allow him.

Iblis came during the end of the life of Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, to Eve saying, ‘I am in a very bad condition because of hunger and thirst.’ Eve asked, ‘What do you want?’ He said, ‘I want you to allow me taste these fruits.’ She said, ‘Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has made me to promise not to feed you anything from these plantations because it is from the garden (paradises) and it is not proper for you to eat anything from them.

He said to her, ‘Squeeze something from them on my palm.’ She refused. He said, ‘Allow me to suck but I will not eat.’ She took one bunch of grapes and gave it to him who sucked but did not eat from it because Eve had stressed on him not to eat. When he was about to bite Eve pulled it out from his mouth

and Allah, most Blessed, most High, revealed to Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam that My enemy and your enemy, Iblis, has sucked the grape and the juice of wine is unlawful for you which is mixed with the breath of Iblis.

Wine became unlawful because of the enemy of Allah, Iblis deceived Eve until he sucked the grape, but if he would eat, grapes would have become unlawful from the beginning to end and all of its fruits and what comes out of it.

He then said to Eve, ‘I wish you to allow me to suck from this date as you allowed me to suck the grape. She gave him one date and he sucked it. Grapes and dates had strong smells, finer than musk al -Adhfar (sweet smelling) and sweeter than honey. When the condemned enemy of Allah, Iblis sucked them, their fragrance went away and sweetness reduced.’

Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Iblis, may Allah condemn him, went after the death of Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and urinated on the root of grape vines and palm trees. Water flowed in their veins of the urine of Iblis, the enemy of Allah; and thereafter grape and dates ferment. Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has made it unlawful for the offspring of Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, all intoxicating things because water carried the urine of the enemy of Allah in the palm tree and grape vines. Every fermenting thing becomes wine because water fermented in the palm tree and grape vines and it is because of the urine of the enemy of Allah, Iblis, may Allah condemn him.’”
